name: Checklist — Project Setup
description: Half-frame progress-tracker checklist (right column horizontal, bottom panel vertical): title + five numbered tasks over footage; completed items carry the red marker strike — item 1 statically struck from frame 0, item 2 draws through mid-clip (the check-off beat) and dims to done. INTENTIONAL: the strike keeps hand-marker physics (wobble/overshoot at the strike mark's tool default) on the flat channel card — the check-off is the block's emotional payload; do not flag hand-energy-on-chrome as an aesthetic-miss. Grit overlay and torn edges omitted intentionally: this is flat chrome, not a paper substrate.
